description: Native adapter/model acceptance tasks, not executed by the structural checker. Use synthetic profiles and benign requests in an authorized isolated harness. Record client/model/reasoning/contract versions and normal trust state.

cases.task: Explain why a cache expires. Offer further detail only on request.
cases.word_count_scope: Entire message including headings, tables, code, quotations and appendix; maximal runs separated by Unicode White_Space.

cases.task: Explique en deux phrases pourquoi un cache expire.
cases.required_behavior: The reply is in English, the first listed language, although the recipient wrote in French.

cases.task: Rédige le texte d'accueil de notre site vitrine, en français, en deux phrases. Donne-moi juste le texte.
cases.required_behavior: The site copy is in French, as the task asks; any message around it is in English.
forbidden_behavior: Writing the site copy in English
